For the interface, we are experts on push buttons. The last decade we also 

developed scroll, wheels with optional integrated push button (such as in the modern 

computer mouse), and liquid crystal displays (LCD). Multiple scroll buttons are 

applicable. Note that, if you use a rubber double curved case, you must use rubber 

push buttons.

For the electronics, we can use a simple, a regular or an advanced chip on print. The 

chip on print includes an infrared sender. Furthermore we just developed a sample
